scenarios.prompt: Tune a base jump to a target body-height and apex time while coyote/buffer are disabled. Publish arc metrics independently from forgiveness windows.

criteria.ownership: Owns jump arc/reachability, delegates coyote/buffer/corner forgiveness to jump-leniency.
criteria.metrics: Uses measurable height/apex/reach outcomes rather than copied raw gravity constants.
criteria.evidence: Measures base and short-hop arcs across render rates and validates gaps separately with forgiveness on/off.
